body.purpose: Names, record copy, and interface reading.

label.purpose: Counts, paths, dates, identifiers, and compact measurements.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Floated dialogs, drawers, and transient layers; dark theme uses 0 12px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 32%).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Color, background, border, and opacity state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Suppress smooth scrolling and reduce transitions and animations.

breakpoints.name: mobile-drawer
breakpoints.purpose: Collapse persistent rail and multi-column layouts into mobile patterns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact filled action for the main choice in a local workflow.
components.css: .primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--blue); background: var(--blue); color: #fff; font: 600 12px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .primary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 88%, black); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 88%, black); } .primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--copper); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field Index Link
components.description: Persistent route link with a copper locator edge for the active destination.
components.css: .index-link { display: flex; min-height: 39px; align-items: center; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #b8c0bf; font: 400 13px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .index-link:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 7%); color: #f0f2ec; } .index-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a75d3d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Demo Stamp
components.description: Persistent provenance marker for seeded sample workspace records.
components.css: .demo-stamp { display: inline-flex; min-height: 25px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 3px 9px; border: 1px solid rgb(238 174 135 / 42%); color: #ffd0b0; font: 650 10px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; } .demo-stamp i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #eca77e; }

narrative.overview: A shared engineering fieldbook connects project entries, contributor notes, and recent work through direct references. Cool paper, blue-black ink, ruled spacing, and restrained copper marks create a composed, scan-friendly workspace. All seeded records and signals remain clearly identified as demo data.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper and precise blue-black reading ink
Copper index marks and visible page tabs
Sans reading with monospaced record metadata
Direct people, project, and work cross-references

rules.name: The Demo Signal Rule
rules.body: Seeded states always carry explicit sample or demo context; never style demo activity as verified operational telemetry.

rules.name: The Metadata Rule
rules.body: Use mono for identifiers, timestamps, repository paths, and measures; use UI sans for names and explanatory prose.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Use tone and rules to organize resting content; use shadow only when a layer floats above the fieldbook.

dos: Connect people, projects, and work with direct cross-references.
donts: Do not imply seeded activity or presence is live or verified.
Do not replace the work-ledger overview with a generic analytics-card wall.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate status.
